name: Spell-Slinger’s Puppet

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: Bonus Action while held makes the doll hover at a visible empty point within 30 feet for 1 minute.
text: Reference-only: Bonus Action while held makes the doll hover at a visible empty point within 30 feet for 1 minute. Bonus Actions move it up to 30 feet, staying within 30 feet of you, or end the effect. While within 30 feet, speak through it, including Verbal spell components even if you cannot speak.
